title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta13

## Cutting-height device-write field test

This beta changes one deliberately narrow part of the global cutting-height
write path for electronic-height mowers.

The cloud persistence request is unchanged:

- endpoint: private-cloud `save-set-data`;
- `operation_type=iot_set`;
- `height` remains a decimal numeric value.

Only the immediate mower command changes.

Previously Navimower encoded the device-side `height` value as hexadecimal
text, following the encoding used by several other numeric mower settings.
For example, 35 mm was sent to the mower as `"23"`.

Independent community field evidence for cutting height shows that `height`
is reported as decimal text and that a decimal device-side value persists on a
real mower. Beta13 therefore sends cutting height to the mower in that same
decimal string representation:

- 25 mm -> `"25"`
- 30 mm -> `"30"`
- 35 mm -> `"35"`

All other numeric settings keep their existing encodings.

This is intentionally a focused field-validation beta. The observed rollback
has been reproduced on H215, i215 and X390, with different delays before the
previous value returns. Testing the same one-variable encoding change across
those mower families should distinguish a device-write mismatch from a cloud
persistence problem.

No Map Card update is required.
